structured.feedback: It wrongly calls the 2-pack a "spare/backup" (twice) instead of a shampoo-and-conditioner pair, makes an unsupported "fraction of the cost of replacing bottles" claim with no price data, and mixes features and benefits instead of clearly separating them.
